# Where is my data stored?

By default, Acme stores customer data in its United States region.

## Choosing a region

Customers can choose to have their data stored in the European Union region instead. EU data residency is available on the Enterprise plan and must be requested through support before your workspace is created.

A workspace's region cannot be changed after creation. Moving a workspace between regions requires creating a new workspace and re-running the initial sync.

## What stays in region

Synced records, connection configuration and activity logs are stored in the region you choose. Billing records and support correspondence are stored in the United States regardless of workspace region.
